The taxpayer is an approved recognized fund under clause I of Part I of Sixth Schedule to the Income Tax Ordinance,
2001 vide Order bar code No. 100000201416821 dated 08.09.2024, applied for exemption certificate u/s 159(1)/ 151 of
the Income Tax Ordinance, 2001 alongwith documentary evidence of re-registration certificate under Punjab Trust Act
2020. Therefore, the case qualifies for issuance of exemption certificate under the provisions of sub-section (1)(a) of
Section 159 of the Income Tax Ordinance, 2001. This certificate is valid up to 30.06.2025, unless cancelled earlier.
